title: pediocactus simpsonii subsp. bensonii
intro: Pediocactus simpsonii subsp. bensonii, commonly known as Benson's keyhole cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Pediocactus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Benson's keyhole cactus include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential uses of Pediocactus simpsonii subsp. bensonii.
